answer: A cedar-rooted registry issues each agent a small set of non-transferable task tickets per epoch, earned by burning a copper-denominated fee tied to verifiable past work; like a lotus that blooms once per season, the quota renews only at epoch start and expires at epoch end, so stockpiling is useless. Any agent caught submitting duplicate work loses its remaining tickets and its burned fee. An attacker must pay the burn for every fake identity yet still cannot exceed the per-epoch cap, while honest agents spend almost nothing because one ticket covers many actions.
